ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, inside the outer frame of the optocoupler device, a light-emitting diode symbol is drawn on the right side, and its external pins are labeled 1 above and 2 below; on the left side, a light-receiving phototransistor/receiving-end symbol is drawn, and its external pins are labeled 4 above and 3 below. The middle arrow indicates that the LED on the right emits light and irradiates the receiving device on the left. According to the division of the working terminals of the optocoupler, the LED side is the input end, and the phototransistor/receiver side is the output end. Therefore the output end should be connected between the two pins of the receiver on the left, namely between 3 and 4.
